title: Ann Arbor Research Site (Broken Dawn)
summary: A Broken Dawn research destination this archive cannot place: the reviewed sources say only that the search leads into the American Midwest.

claims.text: Broken Dawn's published premise directs its protagonists toward a Midwest research lead involving a potential broad-spectrum antiviral.
The reviewed sources describe a Midwest lead and a possible antiviral but do not name Ann Arbor or a Mantis-directed operation; this archive does not confirm the location or the threat.

paragraphs.text: The reviewed sources put the research lead in the American Midwest without naming a city, so this record stays explicitly unresolved rather than asserting a specific site.
No reviewed source describes a Mantis-directed operation against the lead. The contested part of this record is therefore an open question, not a finding.

verification.notes: Verified against reviewed Broken Dawn sources on 2026-10-12: the publisher catalogue entry is a marketing blurb and names only April Kelleher, Aurelio Diaz and Alex Irvine. Ubisoft's book overview names April Kelleher with Division agents Aurelio Diaz and Ike Ronson. Alani Kelso, the Mantis codename, Ann Arbor, Washington and the intelligence handoff appear in none of them, so those claims are downgraded to unknown and the dependent prose no longer asserts them. Breaking Dawn plot detail needs a readable copy or a detailed chapter summary before it can be restored.
